title: Heidi Health Valuation Doubles to $900 Million on $340 Million Raise
summary:
Melbourne based startup Heidi Health closed a $100 million Series C led by Blackbird alongside $240 million in growth financing from General Catalyst's Customer Value Fund. The investment values the company at $900 million and provides capital to expand its footprint in the US, UK, and Australia, as well as enter Asia and the Middle East. CEO and co-founder Thomas Kelly said the funds will fuel the company's development of agentic AI tools.

The AI Care Partner platform automates clinical notes and provides evidence based reference tools and hardware for clinicians in 110 languages. Heidi reported annual recurring revenue of $50 million this year, with the platform supporting more than 175 million patient visits. Other participants in the funding round included Phoenix Court, Point72 Private Investments, and Headline.

Heidi Health raises $340M to expand its AI Care Partner platform for clinicians

Melbourne based Heidi has closed a $100M Series C led by Blackbird, with participation from Phoenix Court, Point72 Private Investments, and Headline, plus $240M in growth financing from General Catalyst's Customer Value Fund. 

The round values the company at $900M, roughly double its valuation from less than a year ago.

Heidi started as an AI scribe automating clinical notes, and has since expanded into evidence based reference tools, dictation, and its first hardware device. 

The platform has supported over 175 million patient visits across 110 languages, with ARR reportedly hitting $50M this year.

CEO and co-founder Dr. Dr. Thomas Kelly said the funding will fuel expansion into Asia and the Middle East, deepen the company's push into agentic AI tools, and grow its footprint in the US, UK, and Australia.

Another signal of how fast AI is moving into the clinical workflow space.
